issue.body:
Hello! New to Starlette and excited by it. Are there any plans to add a hook for setting a default renderer such that I don't need to explicitly return a JSONResponse? e.g. following code would work:
```
async def posts(req):
    return [{'id': 1}, {'id': 2}]
```
Or, where in the code might you implement a hook to create this?
issue.title: [Question] Will you support default renderers?
